fields.disappearance: Jyeṣṭha Pūrṇimā, the day of Snāna-yātrā (Gauḍīya calendar)
fields.place: Navadvīpa (at the edge of Nadia, Māyāpur); his stall in the bazaar at Bāmanpukur
fields.notes:
A poor brāhmaṇa of Navadvīpa who sold banana leaves, stalks and flowers; half his earnings went to the worship of the Gaṅgā. Young Nimāi haggled with him every day and ate from his leaf plates (Caitanya-bhāgavata Madhya 9). The Lord drank from his broken water pot; at the mahā-prakāśa he saw the Lord as Śyāmasundara and asked only to have «that brāhmaṇa who snatched my banana leaves» as his Lord birth after birth. «The Lord's dear servant» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.67). Counted among the twelve gopālas.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Kusumāsava (Madhumaṅgala), who made Kṛṣṇa laugh (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 133).

fields.name: Raghunātha Vaidya Upādhyāya
fields.notes:
Of Nityānanda's branch (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.26; Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 5.726). Went with Nityānanda from Purī to Bengal by Lord Caitanya's order and on the way was overcome by the mood of Revatī (Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 5.231-239). Present at the Kheturī festival.

Not Raghunātha Vaidya of Caitanya's branch, nor Raghunātha Vaidya, disciple of Narottama (their own records).

fields.name: Raghunātha Vaidya (disciple of Narottama)
fields.notes:
A disciple of Narottama Ṭhākura: «Raghunātha Vaidya and Miśra Haladhara» (Prema-vilāsa 20; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, «Raghunātha Vaidya» 2).

Not Raghunātha Vaidya of Caitanya's branch in Purī (his own record since 05-11-2026), nor Raghunātha Vaidya Upādhyāya of Nityānanda's branch.

Of Śrī Caitanya's branch, a companion of the Lord in Nīlācala: «Raghunātha Vaidya and Raghunātha dāsa» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 10.124-126; Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna, «Raghunātha Vaidya» 1). He is mentioned in Murāri Gupta's Kṛṣṇa-caitanya-carita (4.17.21).

Not Raghunātha Vaidya, disciple of Narottama, nor Raghunātha Vaidya Upādhyāya of Nityānanda's branch.

Of Gadādhara Paṇḍita's branch: «the best of the branches, Śrīdhara Brahmacārī» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 12.79). In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Candralatikā, Rādhā's maidservant (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 194, 199; Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta 5).

Not Śrīdhara Svāmī, the commentator on the Bhāgavatam (his own record since 05-11-2026).

Younger brother of Sūryadāsa Sarakhela, of Śāligrāma; of Nityānanda's branch: «Sūryadāsa Sarakhela and his younger brother Kṛṣṇadāsa Sarakhela had firm faith in Nityānanda» (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.25). One of the six sons of Kaṁsāri Miśra; brother of Gaurīdāsa Paṇḍita. The Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna names Kaṁsāri's fifth son Dīna Kṛṣṇadāsa, a poet who wrote songs on the glories of his elder brother Gaurīdāsa — probably the same person.
